reasoning: The source panel has linear axes labeled P / mbar and CO2 Loading [mmol/g], with printed ticks from 0 to 1200 and 0 to 5. The recreated chart uses the same calibration and places the established high-pressure portions at the source values. Independent source inspection shows that eleven early CO2 273K candidates from panel pixels about (245,528) through (349,313) are not black squares on the steep 273K curve; they instead lie well below that curve amid other series. Three early CO2 283K candidates likewise lack red hexagons at their claimed centers and lie well below the native red curve. These false points cause the conspicuous low-pressure excursions in the recreation and are deleted. The source also contains many densely packed markers not safely inventoried by the candidate, especially for CO2 273K, 283K, 313K, 323K, and 373K. Their individual centers or ownership cannot all be resolved confidently from the full-panel raster, so no points are added merely to complete or smooth curves.

x.reason: The source x axis is linear P / mbar with printed labels 0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000, and 1200. Apart from the false low-pressure points addressed separately, the recreated marker positions have the same pressure spacing as the source.

y.reason: The source y axis is linear CO2 Loading [mmol/g] with printed labels 0 through 5. The established high-pressure endpoints in the recreation coincide with the source values, including approximately 5.0 mmol/g for CO2 273K.
